来WISE大会Vibe Coding，赢价值11999元电脑！ 
   给你60分钟、一台华硕天选电脑和一位搭子，你能用AI做出一个怎样的作品？ 
   这次，来WISE现场参加华硕天选60min极速黑客松试试！ 
   我们邀请有Vibe Coding实战经验的你，带上队友参加一场限时创作挑战。仅招募3支队伍、共6人，赛题现场揭晓，60分钟从零做出一个能玩的作品。 
   现场将提供华硕天选系列电脑作为比赛用机，感受硬核性能，同时开放WorkBuddy积分助力创作。 
   你们负责把想法变成作品，在观众面前展示创作过程，接受评委的现场试玩和提问，让更多人看到你们使用AI解决问题、完成交付的能力。 
   获胜团队将获得1台天选Air 2026 锐龙AI Max+388 8060s独显级核显 32G+1T笔记本电脑！ 
   为什么你适合来？ 
   我们希望你在近三个月内独立使用 AI 编程工具完成过可运行作品，熟悉Vibe Coding，能够在限时挑战中判断需求、解决问题并完成交付。 
   报名时须完成两人组队，由队长统一提交成员基本信息、1个可直接打开并操作的作品链接、100

Drop generic 'finan' / 'finance' branding unless it names Finan / SoBanHang.
companies.FizzDragon: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident startup. Limited public-English information beyond the directory listing — drop unrelated 'FizzDragon' brand mentions unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 SG entity.

companies.Qallix: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident startup. Limited public-English information beyond the directory listing — drop unrelated 'Qallix' brand mentions unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 SG entity.

Carta challenger now powering Schwab Private Issuer Equity Services in the US. Drop unrelated Qatar/Q-brands.

companies.SalesMind AI: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident sales-AI startup. Drop unrelated 'SalesMind' branded vendors (Salesmind.ai LinkedIn outreach, etc.) unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 SG entity.
companies.Taidii: BLOCK71 Suzhou-listed Singapore preschool / childcare-school-management SaaS (HQ Singapore, Suzhou ops listed twice in directory — folded here) covering attendance, billing, e-enrollment, e-forms, finance, parent-school communication; >50% private-school market share in Singapore; ECDA-approved vendor; VAMS 4S sub-second attendance / temperature device; presence in Singapore, China (Suzhou), UAE, Australia and the Philippines. Drop generic 'taid' / 'tide' branding news unless it names Taidii.
companies.Tuc Thoi Service Corporation: BLOCK71 Saigon-resident Vietnamese service-corporation startup. Limited public-English information beyond the directory listing — drop unrelated mentions unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 Saigon entity.
companies.WiSe: NUS GRIP-incubated Singapore deep-tech startup. Very generic — drop any item not clearly about this specific Singapore startup.
companies.dConstruct Robotics: BLOCK71 Silicon Valley-listed Singapore deep-tech robotics startup building SLAM-based autonomous navigation and 3D digital-twin systems for construction, defense and logistics (d.ASH platform, d.ASH Nav self-driving stack, d.ASH Xplorer 3D mapping). Founded 2021 by Chinn Hwa Lim; signed MOU with Foxconn on SLAM/AMR manufacturing. Generic 'construct' wording — drop items about unrelated construction software or DIY robotics kits.
companies.pQCee: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident post-quantum cybersecurity startup (founded 2022) building scalable encryption + key-lifecycle management; flagship SafeQuard™ document-protection tool (NIST-aligned post-quantum crypto); use cases span quantum-proofing docs, securing Web3 against quantum threats and protecting comms. Supported by the US$15M CyberSG Talent, Innovation and Growth (TIG) Collaboration Centre (NUS × CSA).
companies.seamless: Seamless XR — NUS GRIP-incubated Singapore deep-tech startup (soft-robotics / pneumatic micro-haptics; Artemis somatosensory assessment platform; CEO Ajinkya Bhat). 'Seamless' is a highly generic English word ('seamless integration', 'seamless experience') — drop any item not clearly about this specific Singapore startup.

llm_fetch_required.hint: WordPress (Yoast SEO) press-release page on hicuramedical.com. Each item is a row containing a publisher logo/thumbnail, a bolded headline (in <strong> tags rather than h2/h3), a short description, and a 'View Article' link to an external publisher URL. No explicit per-item date elements; dates only appear inline within some headlines (e.g. '2023'). Resolve relative links against https://hicuramedical.com/.
llm_fetch_required.label: press

llm_fetch_required.hint: SENSORI Healthcare news listing. Items are tagged 'News' and ordered newest-first. Resolve relative links against https://www.sensorihealthcare.com.

llm_fetch_required.hint: Soynergy WordPress news category listing.
